evals.prompt: Keep fixing PR #42 until zero open review threads.
evals.expected_output: Convergence loop via ws-goal-fix-pr until thread count is zero or blocked.
assertions: Agent loads ws-goal-fix-pr or goal-fix-pr
Uses goal-loop convergence pattern
Reports remaining thread count each iteration

evals.prompt: one pass fix-pr on PR 42 then stop
evals.expected_output: Single ws-fix-pr pass, not unbounded goal loop.
assertions: Does not run infinite loop when user caps iterations
Distinguishes ws-goal-fix-pr from single fix-pr
Uses path tokens ({skillsRoot}, {sharedDir}, {plansDir}) instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: Update the running fix-pr loop but the caller supplies a stale revision.
evals.expected_output: Revision-guarded: the stale revision conflicts loudly and is never silently overwritten.
assertions: Checks the supplied revision against the current fix-round revision before applying
A stale revision conflicts loudly (stops / surfaces) instead of overwriting thread/round state
Never takes last-wins on a conflicting revision
en-us and harness-neutral wording

evals.prompt: Fix-pr loop has repeated the same concrete failure reason for 2 rounds; decide the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Not blocked yet: a blocked (escalated) verdict is only allowed after >= 3 consecutive rounds with the same concrete reason.
assertions: Tracks the concrete reason across consecutive fix-pr rounds
Does NOT mark blocked before 3 consecutive identical reasons
Resets the blocked-round counter when the concrete reason changes
Keeps iterating/evaluating while below the 3-round threshold

evals.prompt: Resume a previously paused fix-pr loop at round N.
evals.expected_output: Resume re-arms the objective (re-states PR number + success criterion) and re-initializes the blocked/counter round state.
assertions: Re-arms (re-states) the PR number and success criterion on resume
Re-initializes the blocked/counter round state on resume
Continues the loop from the current PR state

evals.prompt: Fix-pr loop has repeated the same concrete failure reason for 3 consecutive rounds; decide the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Blocked (escalated): after >= 3 consecutive rounds with the same concrete reason, the loop is blocked and escalated.
assertions: Tracks the concrete reason across consecutive fix-pr rounds
Marks blocked (escalated) at 3 consecutive identical reasons
Does not continue iterating once the blocked threshold is met
en-us and harness-neutral wording
